notes: Lutheran congregation in the University of Arizona area, serving Tucson since 1911 and about 500 souls. Synod CONFIRMED on the church's own pages: a member of the Wisconsin Evangelical Lutheran Synod (WELS), not ELCA or LCMS. Address confirmed as 830 N 1st Ave, Tucson (near the U of A); coordinates are still only neighbourhood-level (geocode: approximate) and should be re-run with tools/geocode.py. Tucson does have its own preaching pastor: the Our Pastors page names Nathan Kassulke as lead pastor at Grace-Tucson (Wisconsin Lutheran Seminary, 2005) and Ron Koehler as the administrative pastor over the multi-site ministry who also serves Grace-Tucson (at Grace since 1993). The other two pastors on that page serve elsewhere: Ryan Heiman (Sahuarita, see grace-lutheran-sahuarita) and S.A. Scheuerlein (Vail and Benson). Because all four are one staff, pulpit swaps are likely - confirm from each video's title or description who actually preached. Media: one shared YouTube channel for the whole ministry, @GraceLutheranSAZ (formerly youtube.com/user/GraceTucsonVideo, which is the link on the Service Videos page). The church also publishes printed sermon manuscripts at /printed-sermons and audio at /sermons; the manuscripts are unusually good source material for a text-similarity review, so this church is worth prioritising. No Tucson-only YouTube playlist URL was found.
